adapter.policy_output: 32x8 Franka Panda joint-position targets @15 Hz (7 joints rad + 1 grip raw), state-conditioned
adapter.obs: DROID concat_view 540x640 from cam_high only (wrist slot 360x640 + two 180x320 exterior slots, cam_high replicated x3); prompt=task
adapter.cond_joints: DROID-neutral q0=[0,-0.5,0,-2.0,0,1.6,0.8] on reset; afterwards last predicted joint row of previous chunk
adapter.fk: numpy modified-DH Franka FK (7 rows: a/alpha/d table, +0.107 m flange offset; verified q=0 -> (0.088,0,0.926)) -> EE xyz per joint row, Franka base frame
adapter.deltas: finite-difference between consecutive FK EE positions; first delta vs FK of conditioning joints
adapter.frame: identity: Franka base assumed z-up like sim world (coarse; DROID camera frame != our mast view)
adapter.scaling: per-step EE delta clipped to <=25 mm, then integrated from CURRENT measured left EE xyz -> absolute world targets
adapter.rotation: held constant at measured left rot6d (predicted wrist orientation ignored)
adapter.grip: affine from empirical raw range [-0.07, 1.38] to [0,1], clipped
adapter.right_arm: echoes measured right-arm state (parked by sim)

This is real closed-loop sim data: 9 policy queries, receding horizon K=24 of 25 rows, 200 control steps @15 Hz.
